reason: I'm under $5k a month and already pay a setter, so $147 more before I've landed my next client is a hard no this month. A card-required trial where payments are final after day 3 also feels risky when I'm this tight.
objection: I can't justify another subscription until I land the next client, and there are no customer results anywhere, so I'd be paying $147 to be the guinea pig. I also can't tell if this replaces my setter or just adds a cost on top.
would_change_my_mind: Real results from agency owners at my size (booked calls, not just replies), plus a way to try it without a card, or a price under about $80 a month that I could drop the month I don't land a client.
